rows.text: 笑わなくても大丈夫だよ
rows.english: Hi, little one! Peekaboo! Hello again!

rows.text: おむつを替えなくてもまだ大丈夫だよ
rows.english: It's diaper time. I'll be gentle. I'm here with you.

rows.text: お着替えしたと思ったけどまだだったね
rows.english: Let's put clothes on. One arm first. Other arm next!

rows.text: ミルクを飲み終わるまでは待とうね
rows.english: Let's pause feeding. We can wait now. I'll stay with you.

rows.text: 今日はお散歩には行かないよ
rows.english: Let's go outside! Look at the sky. What do you see?

rows.text: お歌はもう終わったけど絵本はこれからだよ
rows.english: Our book is finished! That's the last page. Well done, sweetheart.

rows.text: ねんねから起きてごはんを食べようね
rows.english: Time for a bite! Here's your spoon. Open wide!

rows.text: まだできあがっていないね
rows.english: Hello, sweet baby! You're so loved. I'm right here.

rows.text: おしまいかどうか分からないね
rows.english: You're my little sunshine. I love you. Big hugs!

rows.text: もう一回はやらなくていいよ
rows.english: One more time? Let's try again. Ready to go?

rows.text: 大丈夫じゃないみたいだね
rows.english: Hello, little one! Can you hear me? Hi there!

rows.text: かわいいけど眠ってはいないね
rows.english: My sweet baby! Big, big hugs! Hello, sweetheart!
